thm:9-unknowns-ZN: 9 Unknowns in ${\mathbb Z}$ ${\mathbb N}$
nodes.statement:
For all $a \in {\mathbb N}$ the following are equivalent: 
\begin{gather} 
\exists z_1, \ldots, z_\nu \in {\mathbb N} \colon 
    P(a, z_1, \ldots, z_\nu) = 0 \\
\exists f, g, h, k, l, w, x, y \in {\mathbb Z}, n \in {\mathbb N} \colon 
    Q(a, f, g, h, k, l, w, x, y, n) = 0 \;. 
    
\end{gather}

nodes.name: thm:11-universal-pair: Universal Pair
nodes.statement:
Let $(\nu, \delta)_{\mathbb N}$ be universal. Then
        \[ \big(11, \eta(\nu, \delta) \big)_{\mathbb Z} \]
    is universal where $\eta(\nu, \delta) = 226\,176 \; \delta \, (2 \delta +1)^{\nu +2} + 96 \; \delta \, (2 \delta +1)^{\nu +1} + 226\,176 \; \delta +14\,656$. \\
    In particular, 
    \[ (11,1.16258\cdot 10^{63})_{\mathbb Z} \qquad \text{and} \qquad (11, 9.19593 \cdot 10^{53})_{\mathbb Z} \]
    are universal over ${\mathbb Z}$.
